label: Rewriting the equation
subgoals: Read the equation as a logarithm statement
Rewrite it as the base raised to the value
Isolate the unknown as a power

label: Checking the domain
subgoals: Require the unknown to be positive
Combine logarithms only within the domain
Test each candidate in the original equation

label: Applications
subgoals: Reduce the model to a rewritten logarithm
Divide by the rate or coefficient
Attach the units the model supplies
